From: Grace Li <finance@apachealth.co.nz>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 15:21:00 +1200
Subject: GST withholding — seller residency proof & self-billing?

Hi Alex,

We're preparing the payment run for Q2 and a few of your invoices flagged for GST withholding in New Zealand. Our tax team needs confirmation on the following before we release funds:

- Do you consider Redwood a NZ GST-registered supplier for these invoices, or should we apply the 15% GST withholding as a third-party withholding?
- If Redwood is exempt from withholding via a self-billing exemption, we need a completed tax residency / seller declaration and a copy of the GST registration (or equivalent).

I've attached the tax_residency_form_APACHealth_20250812.pdf for your convenience. Can you confirm which path you prefer and share the requested documents? Mike from Marketplace Asia copied me on similar cases — including him in case this touches marketplace settlement flows.

Thanks,
Grace Li
APAC Health Ltd — Finance

Subject: Re: GST withholding — seller residency proof & self-billing?

Hi Grace,

Thanks for flagging this. Looping in Marissa (billing ops) and Ben (legal/tax) so we can get a clean answer. Quick answers up front: we generally prefer to avoid client-side withholding where a self-billing exemption or supplier residency certificate is acceptable — it keeps the net amount predictable for our customers. That said, we need to confirm the APAC-specific rules here and confirm whether the invoices you have are for marketplace-facilitated sales or direct services — the treatment can differ.

I'll wait for Marissa/Ben to confirm the exact evidence we should provide (GST cert, company registration, signed residency form). If we go the self-billing exemption route, we'll return a signed copy of your form and a copy of our GST certificate.

Alex
Director, Sales Engineering

Alex / Ben — internal notes / recommended approach before we reply to APAC Health: 

1) Evidence we can provide (high priority):
   - Company GST certificate (scanned): seller_gst_certificate_redwood_20250817.jpg
   - Completed tax residency form (signed): tax_residency_form_APACHealth_20250812_filled.pdf (we'll fill their PDF and sign)

3) Suggested invoice doc we can send back: we prepared a simple self-billing invoice template for the flagged invoices (attached): draft_self_billing_invoice_20250812.pdf. That should satisfy APAC Health's accounts-payable auditor.

Action items:

- Ben: if you see any legal issue with the self-billing doc or signatures, flag now.
